beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A very, very long time ago, before houses, before cars, before you, the whole world belonged to the dinosaurs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nobody knows how many there were. But if you stand very still at the edge of the valley, you can still hear them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is the First Morning. The sun has only just climbed over the rim of the world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those are the long-necks. Gentle, enormous, and never in a hurry.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And those small shadows on the wind are pterosaurs. They have been flying since before the mountains had names.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is Rex. He keeps the gate of Dino Park.

beats.speaker: rex
beats.text: Hello there! I roar like thunder, but I am entirely on your side.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Everything lives near this water. The park, the meadow, the racetracks, the sky roads. One whole universe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But one night, something fell out of the sky.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Star seeds. Every single one is a wish the universe made for a new friend.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then Grumblecloud sneezed the biggest sneeze in history, and blew them all across the worlds.

beats.speaker: rex
beats.text: So. Will you help me gather them? Play in every world, and the Starlight Garden will shine again!
